question: With a fixed known vertical load, known rigidity and one known tension, does a single complete normalized-slope profile recover compact curvature source with a local Lipschitz bound uniform near flatness?
scope: Analytic comparison on compatible stationary graphs of the registered projected-source model; separately compare assumptions to existing public-data contracts. Closed numerical branch stays closed.
expected_outcomes: Conditional uniform recovery theorem with named norms
acceptance_checks: Correct flux sign and fixed-load convention
Same-profile source uniqueness and nearby-profile stability distinguished
Regular origin and compact-support terminal condition
Named source/data norms and constants uniform near flatness
Existence only on admitted stationary-profile range unless separately proved
Independent review and explicit gap to empirical controls
stop_condition: One reviewed theorem or exact gap, plus comparison with current observation contracts; zero BVPs, simulation, numerical K, new searches, bulk downloads or new empirical claims.
